title: b7z9.37.2(i): C root-sig DIO option wire format (0x17) + option-table validation
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.37.2. C slice mirroring rust b7z9.37.1(i): rpl_messages.h gains LICHEN_RPL_OPT_ROOT_DIO_SIGNATURE 0x17 (provisional, spec 06 8.10.1 type TBD; keep in sync with rust message.rs 0x17), LICHEN_RPL_ROOT_DIO_SIGNATURE_MIN_LEN 64 (structural garbage floor — true minimum valid COSE ~111B) and MAX 255 (u8 option length). validate_dio_options (messages.c:163) gains a case: reject duplicate singleton options, reject data_len outside [64,255], else accept (COSE blob is byte-transparent; COSE decode is child (ii)). Existing default case skips unknown options, so DIOs WITHOUT the option are unaffected (L679). New standalone host CMake test lichen/tests/rpl_root_sig/ (mirror rpl_dao_auth pattern incl. ../cmake/test_common.cmake and host stubs): byte-exact round-trip of committed vector root_dio_signature_valid_basic cose_sign1 through dio_write_with_options + dio_parse, duplicate rejection, data_len 63 reject / 255 accept, option-less DIO parse unaffected.
